ndps_sections.title: Prohibition of Certain Operations
ndps_sections.description: Prohibits the production, manufacture, possession, sale, purchase, transport, warehousing, use, consumption, import, export and transshipment of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances except as authorized under the NDPS Act.

ndps_sections.title: Punishment for Contravention in Relation to Opium Poppy and Opium
ndps_sections.description: Provides punishment for offences involving opium poppy cultivation and opium.

ndps_sections.title: Punishment for Contravention in Relation to Cannabis Plant and Cannabis
ndps_sections.description: Provides punishment for offences involving cannabis plant, ganja and cannabis resin (hashish/charas).

ndps_sections.title: Punishment for Contravention in Relation to Manufactured Drugs
ndps_sections.description: Provides punishment for offences involving manufactured narcotic drugs such as heroin and cocaine.

ndps_sections.title: Punishment for Contravention in Relation to Psychotropic Substances
ndps_sections.description: Provides punishment for offences involving psychotropic substances including MDMA and methamphetamine.

ndps_sections.title: Financing Illicit Traffic and Harbouring Offenders
ndps_sections.description: Punishes financing illicit trafficking and harbouring persons engaged in narcotics offences.

ndps_sections.title: Abetment and Criminal Conspiracy
ndps_sections.description: Applies to abetment of offences and criminal conspiracy under the NDPS Act.

reference.act: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
